policy_class: Qwen semantic planner + RGB tools + numerical pose skills

model_requests.instruction:
Task: Pick the hotdog bun from the counter and place it in the microwave.
Identify the movable source object to pick up and return its name in target. Images are ordered left camera, right camera, wrist camera. For each view, describe its appearance and give its visible center. All points must refer to that same source object. If it is not visible, set visible false and point_2d null. Use relative coordinates 0 through 1000 on each image; top-left [0,0], bottom-right [1000,1000].

left.description: A hotdog bun with a sausage inside, resting on a small white plate on the counter.

right.description: The hotdog bun is not visible in this view.

wrist.description: The hotdog bun is not visible in this view.

model_requests.instruction:
Task: Pick the hotdog bun from the counter and place it in the microwave.
Source name hint: hotdog bun. Identify ONLY the task source, respecting its object type, shape, and stated source location. The mask must isolate the source itself: exclude its plate, tray, shelf, sink floor and other supports. A mask containing food together with its plate is not a source-only mask. Prefer the tight source-only candidate. Objects already in the destination are not substitutes. A similar color does not establish identity. The source may be outside this view; return visible=false and mask_id=null if none matches. All three images derive from the SAME left camera: original scene, numbered isolated-color masks, then corresponding binary masks. Select the source mask ID and describe its shape and support surface.

response.description: The hotdog bun is a brown, elongated object with a curved top, resting on a white plate on the counter.

model_requests.instruction: Task: Pick the hotdog bun from the counter and place it in the microwave.. Match the SAME task source (hotdog bun) to the source reference crop. LEFT image: previously selected source reference. RIGHT: current camera original scene. WRIST: numbered isolated-color candidate masks from that current camera. Select a mask only for the SAME object identity, comparing shape and appearance across views. The mask must exclude plates, trays, sink floor and other supports: choose the source-only mask, not food plus support. A similarly colored drain or fixture is not a food object.
